title: Analog to Digital Conversion
lead: Covers lecture 05 and exercise 4: why an ADC is needed, resolution, reference voltage and interval size, successive approximation, the ADC registers (ADMUX, ADCSRA, ADCW), the voltmeter systems 8 and 9 (polling and interrupt), the 1023 vs 1024 question, LDR and LM35 sensors, and the auto light exercise. Built from the slides, the 10-bit ADC workbook and peer notes pages 34 to 37. Part 2 (added) explains everything again from zero with diagrams, successive approximation step by step, Vref choice, the interrupt-driven ADC, sensors, the auto light, and section L: what the lecturer said in the 2020 ADC recordings.
